subject: general
question: What is the main purpose of the 'BCC' field in email composition?

options.text: To include multiple main recipients in a single field.
To indicate the importance of the email.
To send copies of the email without revealing the other recipients' addresses.
To attach files to the email.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 'BCC' field in email composition is used to **send copies of the email without revealing the other recipients' addresses**.
 
• BCC stands for **Blind Carbon Copy**.
 
• When you include an email address in the BCC field, the primary recipient and other BCC recipients will not see that email address.
 
• This feature is useful for maintaining privacy among recipients.
 
• It helps in preventing an email recipient from seeing the addresses of other recipients, which is particularly useful in business communications.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other fields in email composition include **'To'**, **'CC'**, and **'Subject'**.
 
• The **'To'** field is used for the main recipients of the email.
 
• The **'CC'** (Carbon Copy) field is used to send a copy of the email to additional recipients, whose email addresses are visible to all other recipients.
 
• Using BCC can help to reduce the chances of recipients' email addresses being harvested for spam.
